question: A mid-cycle increase in clear, stretchy, watery vaginal discharge in a woman with a normal menstrual cycle is a physiological finding caused by peak oestrogen stimulation of endocervical mucus production at ovulation.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is actually correct. Mid-cycle clear, watery, stretchy (spinnbarkeit) discharge is the hallmark of ovulatory cervical mucus under peak oestrogen. It is physiological, not pathological. Only discharge with odour, colour change, pruritus, or inflammation warrants investigation.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. Spinnbarkeit (stretchable, egg-white consistency cervical mucus) peaks at ovulation under maximal oestrogen stimulation. This is normal physiological leucorrhoea. The mucus becomes thick and scant in the luteal phase under progesterone influence.
